summary_ja: リスク・クラス別（一般金利、信用スプレッド、株式現物、株式レポ・レート、コモディティ、外国為替）のデルタ・リスクの感応度の算式と、独自手法の使用を定める。
summary_en: Sets the delta risk sensitivity formulas by risk class (general interest rate, credit spread, equity spot, equity repo rate, commodity, foreign exchange) and permits use of own methods.
paragraphs: Delta risk sensitivities shall be calculated as provided in the following items according to the risk class listed in each item. (i) General interest rate risk: as per the following formula. {{F:p359i0}} {{F:p359i1}} is the delta risk sensitivity of general interest rate risk; r_{t} is the risk-free rate in period t; cs_{t} is the credit spread in period t; V_{i}(r_{t}, cs_{t}) is a function of the risk-free rate and the credit spread as variables, representing the market value of instrument i; (ii) Credit spread risk relating to non-securitization products, securitization products (non-CTP) and securitization products (CTP): as per the following formula. {{F:p359i2}} {{F:p359i3}} is the delta risk sensitivity of credit spread risk relating to non-securitization products, securitization products (non-CTP) and securitization products (CTP); r_{t} is the risk-free rate in period t; cs_{t} is the credit spread in period t; V_{i}(r_{t}, cs_{t}) is a function of the risk-free rate and the credit spread as variables, representing the market value of instrument i; (iii) Equity risk relating to the spot price of equities, etc.: as per the following formula. {{F:p359i4}} s_{k} is the delta risk sensitivity of equities, etc.; k is a given equity, etc. instrument; EQ_{k} is the spot price of equity, etc. k; V_{i}(EQ_{k}) is a function of the spot price of equity, etc. k as a variable, representing the market value of instrument i; (iv) Equity risk relating to equity repo rates, etc.: as per the following formula. {{F:p359i5}} s_{k} is the delta risk sensitivity of equity repo rates, etc.; k is a given equity, etc. instrument; RTS_{k} is the repo rate of equity, etc. k; V_{i}(RTS_{k}) is a function of the repo rate of equity, etc. k as a variable, representing the market value of instrument i; (v) Commodity risk: as per the following formula. {{F:p359i6}} s_{k} is the delta risk sensitivity of the commodity; k is a given commodity; CTY_{k} is the spot price of commodity k; V_{i}(CTY_{k}) is a function of the spot price of commodity k as a variable, representing the market value of instrument i; (vi) Foreign exchange risk: as per the following formula. {{F:p360i0}} s_{k} is the delta risk sensitivity of foreign exchange risk; k is a given currency (other than the reporting currency); FX_{k} is the exchange rate between the given currency and the reporting currency or base currency of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company; V_{i}(FX_{k}) is a function of the spot exchange rate of currency k as a variable, representing the market value of instrument i.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the preceding paragraph, where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company deems it necessary for internal risk management, it may calculate delta risk sensitivities using its own method. In this case, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company using its own method shall notify the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency to that effect in advance.
